meta_title: Connecting with family using your safety code — Anbu
meta_desc: Follow the real app screens: create a safety code, share it, and let your family connect with it.
page_title: Connecting with family using your safety code
page_lead: Anbu connects people with a single safety code. You create the code on your phone and pass it on; your family enters it on theirs.
phone_me: Your phone — where the code is created
phone_family: Your family's phone — where they watch over you
mockup_caption: These are the real app screens, recreated. The code, nickname and phone number are sample values.

steps.d: Open the @nav_settings tab at the bottom of the guardian screen — it sits right at the top. You go from only watching over your family to sending your own check-in as well.
The empty slot fills with a 7-character code. One code is issued per device, and the same code comes back even if you delete and reinstall the app.

steps.h: Copy or share the code with your family
steps.d: The left button copies, the right one shares. Copying shows @subject_home_code_copied. Send it by text or messenger — or just read the 7 characters out over the phone.

steps.h: From here on, this is your family's phone
steps.d: Whoever received the code opens the @nav_connection tab in their own app and taps [@add_subject_button] to reach this screen. Three fields to fill in.
@add_subject_code_info Lower case is converted to upper case. Keep the hyphen (-) in the middle — the code is only recognised with a hyphen between the 3 and the 4 characters.
This is what this person will be called on your family's screen. Unlike the phone number below, it cannot be left empty.
This is how the person's card looks on your family's home screen. The number is optional, and even when it is filled in it never reaches our server — it stays only on the family's phone.
steps.d_after: Once you have called and confirmed that everything is fine, tap [@guardian_confirm_safety]. The alert clears, the status returns to normal, and the other guardians watching along receive a confirmation notice.

steps.d: The button lights up once the code and nickname are filled in. Tapping it connects you, and the card you saw above appears on your family's home screen.

note: Once connected there is nothing left to do. Anbu sends a check-in by itself, every day at the set time, and tells your family if that time passes with no signal. If the signal is late or the step count looks empty, see the FAQ.
